name: BioMistral
qualification: The paper selects 3B tokens of raw PMC-OA article text. Its target of 1.5 epochs is not substituted for a measured consumed-token count.

name: MEDITRON
qualification: Table 1 reports the train split of the corpus, not an independently measured training-exposure total. Both papers and abstracts come from S2ORC. Reused-source total is the sum of the three named source amounts; rounded component totals differ slightly from the rounded headline.

name: Me-LLaMA
qualification: The published recipe imports Pile biomedical text, MIMIC clinical datasets and RedPajama general text. The entire 129B mixture is therefore reused-dataset material under the acquisition-route definition; its content is mixed.

name: MMedLM / MMed-Llama 3
qualification: MMedC combines textbooks, websites and reused datasets. No route-specific token allocation is established. Books are not silently counted as papers or webpages.

name: BioMedGPT-LM / BioMedGPT (PharMolix)
qualification: This row covers BioMedGPT-LM literature CPT only. Later molecule/protein alignment is not folded into the literature count.

name: BioT5 / BioT5+
stage: Multimodal denoising pretraining and multitask tuning
qualification: The source reports task/example counts and maximum lengths, not realized token amounts by acquisition category. Maximum sequence length is not average realized length.

name: BioMatrix
qualification: 304.4B covers text, molecules, proteins and interleaved material. The 79.7B scientific-text bucket mixes direct literature with FineFineWeb, so it cannot be assigned wholly to either route. FineWeb-Edu alone establishes a reused-dataset lower bound; the exact route split is NR.

name: BioMamba
qualification: Derived from approximately 424K PubMed, 42K C4 and 42K Wikipedia sequences of length 1024. These are packed positions, not a measured count of non-padding content tokens. The source sequence proportions conflict with its nominal 80/10/10 mixture; the discrepancy is retained.

name: MedFound
stage: Medical pretraining, diagnostic SFT, preference alignment
qualification: Available source notes do not establish a source-category token split. Clinical/private material is not silently assigned to a public acquisition route.

name: MedGemma
stage: Vision enhancement, pretraining, teacher distillation, RL
qualification: The source reports image/sample counts, including PMC figure-caption samples; these are not token counts. The medical/general token split is not disclosed here.

name: Lingshu
qualification: Counts of image-caption, QA and reasoning examples cannot be converted to tokenizer tokens without the actual sequences.

name: Hulu-Med
qualification: The 16.7M figure is a sample count, not a token budget; the sample mixture is not a token mixture.

name: InfiMed-Foundation
qualification: Section 3.1 imports public medical datasets and general multimodal datasets including DataComp, CCS, OBELICS and MMC4. The approximately 25B general and 5B medical tokens therefore belong to reused datasets; these content domains are not additional acquisition routes.

name: TxGemma
qualification: The 67B figure is consumed fine-tuning tokens over 12 epochs of the TDC-derived predictive task set; it is not 67B unique paper tokens. It does not describe the separate Chat model mixture.

name: BioBERT
qualification: The source reports words and training steps for different variants. Word counts are not tokenizer-token counts; no word-to-token multiplier is applied.

name: PubMedBERT
qualification: The source reports abstracts, words and bytes. Training examples and maximum sequence length do not establish realized tokenizer-token counts.

name: BioLinkBERT
qualification: The 21GB PubMed corpus and proportions of training-instance types do not establish token counts or acquisition-category shares.

name: NatureLM
qualification: Table S1 is a 143.8B scientific corpus, not a paper-only budget. Separate molecule/protein/DNA/RNA/material source datasets establish a reused-data lower bound. The 14.4B general-text and 12.7B interleaved buckets are not assigned to a route without evidence. The 4.0B interleaved-literature count is not assumed to be directly acquired paper tokens.

name: Galactica
qualification: These are lower bounds from explicitly separable sources, summed at the published rounded precision. Direct repository sources are separated from Semantic Scholar imports. The 88B literature headline includes both routes and is not counted twice. Other reference, code and prompt material remains unallocated.

name: Galactica
qualification: The paper reports 450B training tokens. No acquisition-route exposure split is reported; multiplying rounded corpus shares by 4.25 would create unreported values.

name: SciReasoner
qualification: The headline is 206B tokens. The five enumerated scientific-source components add to 166B; the source does not reconcile the remaining 40B. No residual is invented as a web or paper count.

name: LOGOS
qualification: The 44.87B corpus comprises serialized scientific sequences and interaction records drawn from named datasets; the source does not split this headline into separate pretraining and post-training budgets.

name: Tx-LLM
qualification: The reported 709 component datasets and 66 tasks do not establish the number of training tokens. Inherited PaLM-2 pretraining is outside this adaptation row.

name: BioReason
qualification: The reported KEGG and variant record counts are not tokenizer tokens. Generated rationales are a separate derivative, with no disclosed token split here.

name: BiomedCLIP / PMC-15M

name: OLMo 3
